name: qwen38-flash-next-think-stage1
description: Prompts of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next thinking stage-1 corpus (8K, 2026-10-20/21), in the order they were regenerated, with each conversation's reasoning effort. Prompts that overlap the eval sets are already removed.

perfectblend.order: SpecForge prepare_data.py --dataset perfectblend --split-eval (95/5 split, seed 42), file order

opencodeinstruct.order: random ~250K sample (seed 20261020), code-eval decontaminated, shuffled; file order

regeneration.effort: per conversation from the lock (reasoning_effort); shares low/medium/xhigh = 0.4/0.3/0.3 plus 3,818 PerfectBlend and all 1,089 UltraChat conversations at the template default (xhigh)
regeneration.history: earlier answers sent without their reasoning

build.rows: one per assistant turn, history as the server saw it
build.loop_filter: zlib ratio of the last 4,000 characters < 0.10

open-swe-traces.note: agent sessions of the reference agent run: qwen38_flash_next, xhigh effort, harnesses openhands, sweagent, minisweagent (in that order for build_swe_trace_rows.py --harnesses); 97,292 sessions -> 95,596 training rows at 32K and 300 eval sessions. Later revisions add Claude Code, OpenCode and low/medium-effort sessions.
